TextBlock.Text: Protea: Everyone! You may have noticed the asteroid that appears to have crashed into our neighboring water planet.
Protea: I propose we begin an expedition so they we may explore this asteroid and the planet, once and for all.
Borago: I appreciate the sentiment, Protea but me a Paeonia are almost ready to explore the Bramble seed after all this time!
Protea: Of course... My apologies, I was too hasty. Just come back safely, we still have much to explore.
